scripts.lint: oxlint apps packages tests tools docs/governance -c ./.oxlintrc.json --react-plugin
scripts.lint:audit: oxlint apps packages tests tools docs/governance -c ./.oxlintrc.json --react-plugin --jsx-a11y-plugin --vitest-plugin --import-plugin
